text:
Maya (CS): Quick ask — I'm assembling a one-page, customer-facing triage runbook we can hand to customers during onboarding. Focus: tenant warm pools, caching TTLs, batching defaults, and graceful streaming fallback. Need it short and prescriptive so solutions teams can copy/paste.

Jonah (SRE): +1. Keep it action-first: 1) warmup steps customers can run, 2) a small config snippet, 3) failure modes and who to call. Also include a compact checklist for renewal-risk customers.

Priya (CSM): I can convert to customer language. For accounts flagged as renewal-risk, recommend a 7-day prefill cadence and a smoke test 24 hours before renewal. Add a ‘what to watch’ bullet list (latency, error rate, token cost).

Alex R. (Platform PM): Suggested defaults to include: batch_size=8, max_wait_ms=25, prefill_range=3-5 prompts, streaming_fallback=true. Show how to expose as a per-tenant feature flag. Small, opinionated defaults help avoid negotiation with customers.

Sam (Support): Add a quick diagnostic snippet for when the batch queue grows and latency spikes. Also include a CLI for on-demand prefill: `ri prefills --tenant <tenant_id> --count N`.

ops-bot: Deploy started for cs/runbook/warm-pools v1 — build 42

Maya (CS): Nice. Can we add a tiny code/config example customers can paste?

Jonah (SRE): Here — copy/pasteable JSON config for tenant-level settings:

```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-123",
  "warm_pool": {
    "enabled": true,
    "pool_size": 2,
    "prefill_interval_minutes": 60
  },
  "batching": {
    "max_batch_size": 8,
    "max_wait_ms": 25
  },
  "streaming": {
    "enabled": true,
    "graceful_fallback_ms": 3000
  }
}
```

Priya (CSM): Also include a one-line feedback capture example customers can add to their UI: `POST /cs-feedback {"tenant":"acme-123","session_id":"...","rating":4,"note":"model hallucinated on question"}` — we wire that to an eval webhook.

Jonah (SRE): Add recovery/helpful ops commands: 1) drain warm pool and re-prefill: `curl -X POST https://internal/api/tenants/acme-123/warmup` 2) grep logs for warmpool errors: `rg "warm_pool" /var/log/redwood/* | tail -n 200`. Put these under a troubleshooting heading.

Alex R. (Platform PM): I'll assemble the 1-pager and upload to Confluence. @Priya can you review for tone (non-technical reader) and also add the renewal playbook snippet? Target: one page, single column, copyable CLI and JSON.

Maya (CS): One more ask — renewal-risk trigger blurb: something like “if 3 consecutive days of >10% P50 latency regressions or sustained 2x token cost increase, kick off renewal playbook and priority support.” Keep it short.

Priya (CSM): I’ll draft the renewal triggers and step-by-step customer outreach script (email + scheduled walkthrough).

Sam (Support): Added a small local test command customers can run to validate warm pool behavior: `ri-simulate --tenant acme-123 --qps 2 --duration 5m` — logs show warm hits vs cold starts. We can paste sample output.

Alex R. (Platform PM): Great — I’ll have a draft in the doc by EOD, pinging here when live. :thumbsup:

Maya (CS): Thank you all — this will really shorten onboarding calls and catch renewal risks earlier.
